Mathematical Verification

  • Width Arithmetic: 3 cols × 60mm + 2 gaps × 4mm = 188.0mm. Sheet width = 210mm. Margin X = (210 - 188) / 2 = 11.0mm (≥ 5.0mm nominal).
  • Height Arithmetic: 3 rows × 91.6mm + 2 gaps × 4mm = 282.8mm. Sheet height = 297mm. Margin Y = (297 - 282.8) / 2 = 7.1mm (≥ 5.0mm nominal).
  • Crop Mark Clearance: Mark offset = 3mm (= bleed), length = 2mm. Distance between adjacent trims = 2 × 3 + 4 = 10mm. Mark reaches = 3+2 + 3+2 = 10mm. Marks meet at center with 0 collision into any bleed or trim box.
